physical_scale.rule: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale.proportions: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale.abundance_must_not_use: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

selection: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by fragrance_data.notes.
Selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

rules: The bottle is physically supported by a realistic surface.
The bottle is completely vertical and stable; it never floats or tilts.
Use clear foreground, midground and background depth.
Create richness through quantity, grouping, overlap, layers and texture, not oversized ingredients.
Keep generous negative space for Spanish typography.
Typography must never cover the bottle and must remain legible.
The bottle has the highest visual priority.
The bottle is suspended or floating near the visual centre and primary compositional axis.
The bottle remains fully visible, recognizable and clearly separated from other elements.
The top/cap leans slightly left and the base slightly right.
Use a subtle fixed 5-12 degree tilt; never mirror, reverse or alternate it.
Build a physically coherent foreground, midground and background.
Integrate ingredients with the environment; do not make them look like stickers.
Use movement only when physically plausible for the element.
Surrealism comes from suspension, movement, depth, interaction and atmosphere.
Do not use typography or text.

data_rules: fragrance_data.name and fragrance_data.url must match the source product exactly.
Preserve fragrance_data.notes exactly; do not remove or modify original notes.
selected_visual_notes may only use notes present in fragrance_data.notes.
The system assigns gender and bottle_reference; the model must not invent them.
